change: The generated web target sets exactOptionalPropertyTypes to false.
reason: The transplanted Starter/Saas UI source currently relies on optional component props that are not assignable under the repository-wide exact optional property contract.
evidence: At generated-target proof commit acbced929, enabling exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true after the production build produces 34 web type errors (28 TS2375 and 6 TS2379), primarily optional component props receiving undefined; the relaxed override remains required.

change: The generated web target sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess to false.
reason: The transplanted Starter/Saas UI source indexes registry and fixture collections without handling undefined values under the repository-wide indexed-access contract.
evidence: At generated-target proof commit acbced929, enabling noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true after the production build produces 13 web type errors (8 TS18048, 1 TS2322, 2 TS2345, and 2 TS2532), from unchecked collection/indexed values; the relaxed override remains required.
